A.depoimento:
Marched all available troops from Lisboa to Santarem to seize the neutral village and expand our kingdom.
We hope to capture it next turn and gain its resources.
No enemy armies were sighted. Our forces remain ready for further expansion.
A.plano: Next turn, expect to hold Santarem. Build more troops in Lisboa and Santarem to prepare for Evora. Keep watch for enemy movements from unseen villages. Do not split forces; keep a strong garrison.

A.depoimento: This turn I sent archers to take Coimbra and spearmen to take Badajoz. I built spearmen in Lisboa for future expansion. Our holdings grew to four villages.
A.plano: Next turn, expect to hold Coimbra and Badajoz. Build more troops in Lisboa and Santarem to prepare for Evora and other neutrals. Keep watch for enemy movements from unseen villages. Do not split forces; keep a strong garrison.

B.depoimento: I launched my full garrison to take both neighboring neutrals, overwhelming Tarragona with spearmen and Girona with archers. The victories give me two new villages and a stronger foothold for expansion.
B.plano: Capture Tarragona and Girona this turn to secure three villages. Next turn, train additional archers and spearmen at Barcelona and the new villages, then push northeast toward Zaragoza and Valencia to expand control of the eastern corridor and threaten the enemy capital.

A.depoimento: This turn we marched 4 spearmen from Lisboa to capture Evora, and sent 3 knights from Santarem to reinforce Badajoz. We built a knight in Lisboa and an archer in Santarem to prepare for future offensives.
A.plano: Next turn, expect to hold Evora. New knight in Lisboa and archer in Santarem will be ready. Knights arriving at Badajoz will strengthen our attack force. Use these to target Faro, Porto, Toledo, Salamanca, and Sevilha in the coming turns while continuing to build troops as resources allow.

B.depoimento: I ordered Barcelona to train two archers for future offensives. From Tarragona I dispatched a mixed force to Zaragoza and a spear-only squad to Castellon. From Girona I sent all archers and knights to seize Huesca.
B.plano: Capture Zaragoza, Castellon, and Huesca this turn to expand control of the eastern corridor. Next turn, use the new villages to gather resources and train more archers and spearmen, then push toward Valencia and threaten the enemy capital.

B.depoimento: I sent two knights from Huesca to seize Teruel, aiming to secure the eastern corridor. Simultaneously, I ordered the production of six spearmen in my interior villages to strengthen future assaults on Pamplona and beyond. No enemy movements were sighted.
B.plano: Capture Teruel this turn using knights from Huesca. Next turn, reinforce the front with the newly built spearmen from Barcelona, Tarragona, and Girona, then seize Valencia and Madrid. After securing the eastern corridor, mass forces to assault Pamplona and advance toward the enemy capital.

A.depoimento: Statement: Sent Badajoz's garrison to take Salamanca, built spearmen and archers across our realms to prepare for next turn's expansion.
A.plano: Plan: Focus on capturing Salamanca with Badajoz's forces; build spears and archers in all villages to reinforce; keep Lisboa as reserve; avoid splitting armies.

B.depoimento:
This turn I ordered the construction of twelve spearmen across my villages and redirected existing spearmen to the front.
Reinforcements are now en route to Castellon and Huesca, preparing for tomorrow's assaults.
My garrisons stand ready to defend while the new troops arrive.
B.plano:
Next turn, capture Valencia from Castellon, Madrid from Zaragoza, and Pamplona from Huesca using spearman-heavy forces.
Following that, reinforce Teruel with spearmen from Castellon to take Toledo, then advance west to Burgos and Murcia.
After securing the central corridor, mass forces to assault the enemy capital Lisboa.
Maintain production of spearmen in interior villages to sustain the offensive.

A.depoimento: Statement: This turn I focused on strengthening my frontier: trained spears in Evora and Santarem, an archer in Coimbra, and a knight in Lisboa. I dispatched troops toward Faro, Porto, Salamanca, and Toledo to prepare for next-turn assaults, while my existing march on Salamanca continues.
A.plano: Plan: Build spears in Evora and Santarem for future Faro/Porto captures; build archer in Coimbra and knight in Lisboa for reinforcement; send troops to position for upcoming attacks; keep small garrisons; do not attempt neutral captures this turn due to insufficient force.

B.depoimento: I sent six spearmen from Castellon to capture Valencia and three spearmen from Zaragoza to reinforce Teruel. I built knights in Zaragoza and Barcelona, and spearmen in the other villages to stockpile for the westward push.
B.plano: Turn 6: Capture Valencia with spearmen from Castellon. Next turn, reinforce Teruel with spearmen from Zaragoza and prepare knights there to take Toledo. After securing Toledo, advance west through Burgos and Murcia to approach the enemy capital. Maintain spearmen production in interior villages to sustain the offensive.

B.depoimento: Sent Zaragoza's knights to take Madrid and Huesca's spearmen+archers to seize Pamplona. Reinforced Zaragoza with infantry from rear villages and sent Valencia spearmen to bolster Teruel. Built knights in most villages to stockpile for the westward advance.
B.plano: Capture Madrid and Pamplona this turn. Reinforce Zaragoza with troops from Barcelona, Tarragona, Girona, Castellon, and Teruel. Strengthen Teruel with Valencia spearmen and the arriving Zaragoza spearmen. Next turn, attack Toledo from Teruel and prepare to take Murcia via Valencia. Continue building knights for the westward push toward the enemy capital.

A.depoimento: Marched all troops from Salamanca to attack Madrid, aiming to seize the enemy village. Built spearmen in each of our villages using available wood, raising our infantry strength. Now we await the battle outcome and ready defenses.
A.plano: Capture Madrid this turn to gain a seventh village. Build spearmen in all villages to increase future attack power. Avoid building archers or knights now to save iron for later. Prepare to reinforce Salamanca after the battle.

B.depoimento: Today we ordered a strong force from Teruel to seize Toledo, while sending knights from our eastern villages to bolster Zaragoza. We also prepared a knight from Madrid to strike at Burgos soon. Our armies march westward.
B.plano: Capture Toledo and Pamplona this turn. Reinforce Zaragoza with knights from the east. Next turn, attack Burgos from Madrid and Zaragoza while securing Murcia via Valencia. Then push westward to Cordoba and Sevilla, aiming to encircle the enemy capital.

A.depoimento: This turn we seized Faro, Porto, Sevilha, Toledo and Burgos with spearmen‑focused forces, raising our held villages to twelve. We also built spearmen in all our settlements to stockpile future attack power.
A.plano: Continue expanding by attacking remaining neutral villages (Vigo, Cordoba, etc.) and reinforce newly captured villages. Keep building spearmen only; avoid archers/knights to conserve iron.

B.depoimento: This turn I launch a knight assault on Madrid from Zaragoza, while moving spearmen from Teruel to Valencia and strengthening Pamplona for future offensives.
B.plano: Capture Madrid this turn with a knight force from Zaragoza. Next turn, use spearmen from Teruel (now in Valencia) to take Murcia via Valencia. Simultaneously, reinforce Pamplona with spear/archer from Zaragoza to prepare an assault on Burgos. After securing Murcia and Burgos, push westward toward Cordoba and Sevilla to encircle the enemy capital.

A.depoimento: Built spearmen in interior villages and sent troops to reinforce Salamanca, Faro, Porto, Toledo, and Santarem. Strengthened defenses and positioned armies for upcoming offensives.
A.plano: Continue building spearmen only to conserve iron. Reinforce border and newly captured villages to strengthen defenses. Prepare forces for future attacks on neutral villages after building up sufficient numbers. Do not attempt archers/knights or risky attacks this turn.

B.depoimento: This turn we seized Toledo, Burgos, and Salamanca, sending spearmen from Teruel, spearmen and archers from Pamplona, and knights from Madrid. Our interior villages produced a wave of spears for the next push.
B.plano: Turn 11: Take Murcia from Valencia with spear force. Turn 12: Capture Cordoba from Murcia. Turn 13: Seize Sevilla from Cordoba. Simultaneously, use Zaragoza to reinforce the front and prepare a western push toward the enemy capital via Evora after securing the western flank.

A.depoimento: I ordered spearmen production in all my villages and sent a strong force from Salamanca to capture Madrid, aiming to secure the enemy's forward village while holding my defenses.
A.plano: Continue building spearmen only to conserve iron. Keep at least one troop in Salamanca as garrison. Next turn reinforce Salamanca with arriving troops and prepare to attack Teruel from Madrid. Avoid risky archer/knight builds.

B.depoimento: I sent reinforcements from Zaragoza: one spear to Valencia, five spears to Burgos, and two archers to Teruel, preparing to seize Toledo and the neutral villages next turn.
B.plano: Strengthen border villages: send spears to Valencia and Burgos, archers to Teruel. Next turn attack Toledo from Teruel/Madrid, capture Murcia and Vigo. Then push toward Cordoba and Sevilla while reinforcing western flank via Zaragoza.

A.depoimento: This turn I ordered spearmen production in every village to boost our manpower. I held my current positions and conserved iron for future archer and knight recruitment. No troops were sent out as we focus on strengthening our homeland.
A.plano: Continue building spearmen to stockpile forces. Keep garrisons strong. Next turn, assess iron reserves to build archers for attacks on Cordoba and Teruel. Avoid sending troops until we have sufficient numbers.

A.depoimento: Launched spearmen attacks on Sevilla and Teruel, and began rebuilding spearmen in all our villages to replace losses.
A.plano: Armies en route to Sevilla and Teruel (arrive in 3 turns). Next turn, focus on rebuilding defenses and scouting enemy movements. Do not split forces; keep garrisons strong.

A.depoimento: Sent cavalry and infantry to strengthen our borders, launched a double wave of spearmen at Sevilha, and ordered new spearmen in every village. Our march to Teruel proceeds as planned.
A.plano: Continue reinforcing Toledo and Madrid while pressing the attack on Sevilha and Teruel. Build spearmen everywhere to replenish garrisons. Keep at least two troops in each village for defense. Do not commit to Burgos or Zaragoza yet.

B.depoimento: Built spearmen in all villages. Sent Valencia and Burgos forces to take Murcia and Vigo. Sent Castellon and Zaragoza troops to bolster Teruel against the approaching enemy army.
B.plano: Capture Murcia and Vigo to increase held villages to 12. Reinforce Teruel to withstand incoming enemy army. Next turn, use newly built spearmen to defend captured villages and prepare assault on Toledo and Madrid.

A.depoimento: Today we launched a coordinated assault on Cordoba, sending 15 spearmen from Toledo and 1 from Sevilha. The attack overwhelmed the neutral garrison, securing the village. Meanwhile, we ordered spearmen production across our lands to replace the troops sent forward.
A.plano: Capture Cordoba this turn; reinforce it next turn with arriving troops. Prepare our 11-spear force heading to Teruel to attack after arrival. Continue building spearmen in all villages to replenish garrisons and maintain at least two troops per village.

B.depoimento: Built archers in key villages to boost anti‑spearmen power. Sent reinforcements to Teruel, Zaragoza, Burgos, and Vigo, and launched probing attacks on Cordoba and Porto. Our forces are gathering for a westward push while holding the eastern front.
B.plano: Strengthen Teruel to withstand incoming enemy army; build archers for future spearman counter. Reinforce Zaragoza, Burgos, and Vigo for defense. Prepare small assaults on Cordoba and Porto to gain villages. Next turn, consolidate forces and press toward Toledo and Madrid.

A.depoimento:
This turn we sent spearmen from Madrid to capture Cordoba and from Lisboa to take Vigo.
We reinforced Madrid with knights from Toledo.
We ordered spearmen production in every village to replenish garrisons.
A.plano:
Next turn, reinforce Cordoba and Vigo with spearmen from Madrid and Lisboa.
Bolster Porto, Toledo, and Madrid garrisons with incoming troops.
Continue building spearmen in all villages.
Prepare to attack Burgos or Zaragoza after strengthening.

B.depoimento: This turn I ordered archers to be built in every village to boost our anti‑spearmen power. I dispatched five archers and four spearmen from Teruel to strike at Toledo, aiming to seize it next turn.
B.plano: Capture Toledo this turn using archers and spearmen from Teruel. Next turn, reinforce Vigo and Murcia with archers from Burgos and Teruel to prepare assaults on Porto and Cordoba. Subsequently, take Porto and Cordoba to reach 15 villages, then mass forces for a push on Madrid. Keep defending Zaragoza and Burgos.

A.depoimento: This turn I trained four new knights and ten archers across my realms, bolstering my elite forces. I dispatched spearmen to fortify Badajoz, Porto, Salamanca and Faro, and launched initial attacks on Vigo and Cordoba to soften them up. My main armies continue marching toward Vigo and Cordoba, set to arrive in two turns.
A.plano: Build knights in Madrid, Lisboa, Salamanca, Evora and archers elsewhere to strengthen forces for next turn. Reinforce Badajoz, Porto, Salamanca, Faro with spearmen. Send probing waves: Porto->Vigo (4 spearmen) and Sevilha->Cordoba (6 spearmen) to weaken enemies, followed by existing marches. Avoid direct assaults on Toledo/Burgos until we have sufficient knights/archers.

B.depoimento:
This turn I seized Cordoba with a combined archer force from Toledo and Murcia, securing a new village.
I sent reinforcements from Zaragoza to Toledo to strengthen its defenses against possible Madrid attacks.
Troops from Pamplona marched to Burgos to fortify our northern front, while a small detachment moved from Burgos to Vigo.
Finally, I ordered villages to build spearmen and archers to replenish our armies for upcoming offensives.
B.plano:
Capture Cordoba this turn using archers from Toledo and Murcia.
Reinforce Toledo with spearmen from Zaragoza to defend against Madrid, and bolster Burgos with troops from Pamplona while sending a detachment to Vigo.
Next turn, reinforce Cordoba and Vigo, then attack Porto and Badajoz to expand front lines.
Finally, mass forces for a push on Madrid to reach 18 villages.

A.depoimento: Statement: Built knights and archers across the realm, sent reinforcements to key borders, and launched attack forces toward Cordoba and Toledo.
A.plano:
Plan: Secure Cordoba and Toledo next turn with reinforced forces.
Continue building knights and archers while strengthening border defenses.

B.depoimento: We struck hard at Madrid, sending a seasoned army from Zaragoza while keeping a shield at home. Our smiths work tirelessly, forging spearmen in every village to replace losses. Toledo and Cordoba stand ready for the counteroffensive next turn.
B.plano: Capture Madrid this turn using spearmen-heavy force from Zaragoza while retaining a defensive core. Next turn, reinforce Toledo with spearmen from Teruel and Cordoba with spearmen from Murcia. Then attack Badajoz from Toledo and Sevilha from Cordoba. Finally, consolidate and push to hold 18 villages.

A.depoimento: This turn I constructed archers in Cordoba and Sevilha and redeployed troops: spearmen from Cordoba to Sevilha, archers from Sevilha to Cordoba. This shifts strength toward preparing the capture of Murcia.
A.plano: Build archers in Cordoba and Sevilha. Move Cordoba's spearmen to Sevilha and Sevilha's archers to Cordoba to concentrate archers for a future attack on Murcia. Do not attack border villages this turn due to insufficient force.

A.depoimento: Built an archer in Cordoba to boost its archer count. Sent two spearmen and one archer from Sevilha to reinforce Cordoba. No attacks were launched this turn as we prepare for a future assault on Murcia.
A.plano: Next turn, Cordoba will have 6 archers and 2 spearmen after reinforcements arrive. Use this force to attack Murcia (village 15) and capture it. Continue building archers in Sevilha for future reinforcements. Avoid attacking stronger enemy positions until we have sufficient force.

B.depoimento:
I ordered 4 elite knights from Madrid to strike at Toledo, aiming to seize the enemy's weak outpost.
Archers from Valencia march to bolster Teruel, while Burgos sends spearmen to strengthen Madrid.
Meanwhile, I began forging new knights in the heartlands to ready our next advance.
B.plano:
Capture Toledo this turn to open the central front.
Next turn, reinforce Toledo and prepare assault on Salamanca with archers from Burgos and Valencia.
Build knights in interior villages to create a mobile reserve for future pushes toward Porto and Cordoba.

A.depoimento: This turn we trained new knights in our interior villages and archers in Sevilha and Cordoba. We sent a force of two spearmen and six archers from Cordoba to capture Murcia. If successful, we will gain a twelfth village and a new foothold in the south.
A.plano: Next turn, secure Murcia with surviving troops and reinforce Sevilha for further archer production. Prepare to attack Vigo from Porto once we have a stronger force. Continue building knights in interior villages for future heavy assaults.

B.depoimento: Sent reinforcements from Valencia, Burgos, and Zaragoza to strengthen Teruel and Madrid. Built archers in Valencia, Burgos, and Zaragoza to stockpile for upcoming offensives.
B.plano: Reinforce Teruel and Madrid this turn; next turn attack Toledo with combined forces to capture it. After securing Toledo, reinforce it and prepare assault on Salamanca using archers from Burgos and Valencia. Build knights in interior villages for a mobile reserve to later push toward Porto and Cordoba.

A.depoimento: Built a knight in Porto and spearmen/archers in Murcia. Sent reinforcements from Santarem, Coimbra, and Cordoba to Porto and Murcia to prepare for offensives.
A.plano: Next turn, attack Vigo from Porto and Valencia from Murcia with reinforced forces. Continue building knights in interior villages for future heavy assaults. Keep border defenses strong.

B.depoimento: Built spearmen and knights across the realm, sent forces from Teruel to seize Murcia and Toledo, and held our front lines.
B.plano: Capture Murcia and Toledo this turn. Next turn reinforce captured villages and prepare to take Salamanca from Madrid and Porto from Vigo. After securing Salamanca, push toward Cordoba via Murcia. Build knights in interior villages for mobile reserve.

B.depoimento: This turn we march on Cordoba with a spear from Toledo, dispatch archers from Zaragoza, Burgos, Pamplona and Huesca to Madrid, and send knights from Barcelona, Tarragona, Girona and Castellon to Valencia to prepare upcoming offensives.
B.plano: Capture Cordoba this turn. Next turn, mass archers from Madrid to take Salamanca and knights from eastern cities to reinforce Valencia for a Murcia strike. Simultaneously, send archers to Toledo for future Badajoz and Sevilha attacks. Build archers in Huesca, Pamplona, Burgos, Toledo, Vigo and knights in Barcelona, Tarragona, Girona, Castellon, Zaragoza, Madrid, Teruel for reserves.

A.depoimento: This turn I ordered barracks in all my villages to boost spearmen and archers. I sent Porto's army to take Vigo and Sevilha's force to capture Cordoba. Both attacks should succeed, expanding my control.
A.plano: Secure Vigo and Cordoba this turn while reinforcing border villages. Build spearmen and archers everywhere to prepare for future assaults on Toledo, Madrid, and Valencia. Avoid attacking strong enemy positions until we have sufficient forces.

B.depoimento: Valencia’s knights and archers stormed Murcia, while Madrid’s spearmen and archers took Salamanca. I sent archers from Burgos to Vigo and from Teruel to Toledo to prepare for Porto and Badajoz attacks. I also began building archers in Cordoba for a future Sevilha assault.
B.plano: Capture Murcia and Salamanca this turn. Next turn, mass archers from Burgos and Huesca to Vigo for Porto strike, and from Teruel and Zaragoza to Toledo for Badajoz strike. Build archers in Vigo, Toledo, and Cordoba to reinforce. Hold interior villages and prepare to take Sevilha after Murcia falls.

A.depoimento: We launched a strong assault on Cordoba using Sevilha's spearmen and archers, reinforced our northern borders with troops from Santarem and Evora, and began producing spearmen and knights across our realms to prepare for future offensives.
A.plano: Hold Cordoba after the attack; reinforce Coimbra and Porto against Salamanca; continue building spearmen and knights in all villages; avoid attacking strong enemy positions like Toledo or Valencia until we have superior numbers.

A.depoimento: This turn I ordered each of my villages to train two spearmen, boosting my forces. I sent a mixed detachment from Santemar to Coimbra and another from Coimbra to Porto to strengthen our borders against Salamanca. My marching reinforcements from Faro will reach Sevilha next turn.
A.plano: Continue building spearmen in all villages to increase garrison. Reinforce Coimbra and Porto from Santemar and Coimbra. Prepare to attack Vigo after gathering sufficient forces next turn. Avoid attacking strong enemy positions until we outnumber them.

B.depoimento: We struck Cordoba with Murcia's knights and Coimbra with Salamanca's archers, while marching Madrid's archers to Salamanca to prepare for the Porto offensive.
B.plano: Take Cordoba and Coimbra this turn. Next turn, mass archers at Salamanca to capture Porto, reaching 18 villages. Then defend and expand.

A.depoimento: Today we ordered spearmen production in every village to strengthen our armies. We marched 8 spearmen and 2 archers from Sevilha to attack the enemy-held Cordoba, leaving a small garrison behind. If successful, we will gain a new village and move closer to victory.
A.plano: Continue building spearmen in all villages to boost garrison. Keep a small garrison in Sevilha while sending the main force to Cordoba. After the attack, prepare to reinforce Sevilha and assess the outcome. Avoid spreading forces thin until we secure Cordoba.

B.depoimento: This turn we marched a force of 14 spearmen, 15 archers, and 1 knight from Salamanca to Porto, aiming to take the enemy port and reach 18 villages under our control.
B.plano: Capture Porto this turn to reach 18 villages, then hold it and strengthen Salamanca's defenses. Next turn, mass archers at Salamanca and prepare to press toward Badajoz or Sevilha while securing our rear.

A.depoimento: This turn I marched a strong force from Badajoz toward Salamanca, aiming to seize the enemy's key outpost. I ordered spearmen production in every village to replenish my ranks. My other holdings stand firm while I focus on this thrust.
A.plano: Next turn, reinforce Badajoz garrison and prepare to attack Toledo or Coimbra after securing Salamanca. Continue building spearmen in all villages. Do not split forces; keep main army concentrated.

B.depoimento: We sent six archers from Toledo to retake Cordoba, winning the village. Toledo's archers are being rebuilt to sustain the offensive.
B.plano: Recapture Cordoba this turn to reach 18 villages. Hold it and reinforce Salamanca's defenses. Next turn, mass archers at Salamanca to press toward Badajoz or Sevilha while securing interior villages.

B.depoimento:
We marched our full Toledo garrison to Badajoz and secured the village, bringing our total to 18 held villages.
The enemy army en route to Salamanca will arrive next turn, but our defenses hold.
B.plano: Capture Badajoz this turn to reach 18 villages. Hold Badajoz and reinforce Toledo defenses. Next turn, mass archers at Salamanca to press toward Sevilha while securing interior villages.

B.depoimento: Launched an attack on Sevilha from Badajoz with 9 spearmen, 2 archers, and 1 knight. Sent 2 archers from Porto to bolster Badajoz's garrison. Began building spearmen in Teruel and archers in Vigo for upcoming offensives.
B.plano: Capture Sevilha to reach 18 villages next turn. Reinforce Badajoz with Porto troops to hold the frontier. Build spearmen in Teruel and archers in Vigo to strengthen future pushes toward Cordoba and Salamanca.
